body: Still open when AUDIT.md was retired (6 Nov 2026; the file is now the frozen section `audit` of docs/history/reviews-2026-10-31.md): F30: *Found while walking F21 (`../evidence/README.md#b10`).* On a **fresh sign-in the app stays in the old music-server mode for about two minutes** (1 min 59 s and 2 min 50 s measured) before it switches to Encore mode by itself; until then the page says "It is added to your library first", and Add to library and Download run the old code path || *Measured, cause not found.* The server log shows the identity probe and two looks at `/info`, then the upgrade call (`POST migrate/navidrome`, device login, cover pass, library feed) only after the retry pause (`ServerSession._detectAndUpgrade` waits 2 minutes, doubling). The first look does not lead to the upgrade | The first look after sign-in leads to the upgrade at once (find why it does not), or the app says "Getting ready" and keeps Add to library and Download off until Encore mode is on; a first-run walk with a stopwatch. Likely part of what the owner saw: he tapped right after installing
